title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-11-08
lineage: Master Cassette > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN > Remastering > FLAC
source: Unknown Mic > Sony TC124 (4 Ampex C361-90). Recorded with unknown dynamic mics, spread approx. 25-30 ft.

ai_review.summary: Good audience‑sourced tape captures a stellar Dark Star and powerhouse Truckin', though the sound is modestly lo‑fi.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers rave about the improvisational fire of this show – especially Dark Star, an excellent Truckin', and psychedelic renditions of Dancing in the Streets, Not Fade Away and Good Lovin'. The recording is an audience capture from the early ’70s with a warm, slightly “stereo‑ish” vibe that isn’t pristine but adds historic ambience. Overall the musical performance outweighs the modest audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong praise for performance (2×5‑star, 1×3‑star) and consistent highlights of Dark Star and jam quality; recording is described as decent but not high‑fidelity, leading to a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience vibe from the era is appreciated; reviewers note a richer, almost stereo feel compared to typical tape but still lo‑fi and not crystal clear. No major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its jam‑vehicle momentum, with Dark Star and Truckin' serving as high points and the band delivering psychedelic transformations of classic R&B hits.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s improvisational jams, especially on Dark Star, are highlighted as fabulous.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir is described as “tripping balls” during the show.
